Work Environment This role operates within a dynamic sales team environment, focusing on leadership and strategic contributions to local brand strategy. The position involves working closely with healthcare professionals and key accounts within the pharmaceutical sector. Career Development This opportunity is designed for individuals seeking to further develop their leadership career within a leading pharmaceutical environment, contributing to the growth of strategic and newly launched products.

0d7bfe2b9cecc1cb.description: About the Role HCLTech is seeking a Subject Matter Expert (SME) specializing in Ansible, Terraform, and GitHub for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role is integral to ensuring the timely resolution of escalations and incidents within the support and operations domain, with a strong focus on quality compliance, customer satisfaction, and knowledge sharing. Role Purpose The SME will play a critical role in delivering exceptional service to clients by leveraging automation tools and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. This position requires a professional who can manage complex technical issues, mentor team members, and engage directly with customers to enhance satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Ensure timely resolution and quality compliance of escalated tickets and incidents using Ansible and Terraform automation tools, adhering strictly to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Mentor team members and administrators in the effective use of GitHub and Git for version control, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and maintaining comprehensive documentation and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Validate change order implementation plans and human error compliance, leveraging Jenkins for continuous integration and deployment, and actively participate in capacity planning to ensure operational efficiency. Engage with customers through meetings to gather feedback, addressing issues promptly while utilizing Cloud Build for automated deployment processes to enhance customer satisfaction. Conduct thorough analyses, including Root Cause Analysis and Trend Analysis, utilizing data from support incidents to create insightful reports for presentation to key business stakeholders. Required Skills and Expertise Proficiency in Ansible and Terraform for automation. Strong understanding and practical experience with GitHub and Git for version control. Experience with Jenkins for continuous integration and deployment. Familiarity with Cloud Build for automated deployment processes. Ability to conduct Root Cause Analysis and Trend Analysis. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for customer engagement and team mentorship. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where the SME will work within a dynamic support and operations team, collaborating with administrators, customers, and business stakeholders. Application Process Candidates interested in this SME role with expertise in Ansible, Terraform, and GitHub are encouraged to apply.

0da4fa9963994391.company_name: مؤسسة بوابه الشعله لبيع قطع لغيار لتجارة الجملة و التجزئة
0da4fa9963994391.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أموري ديل باشن عن أمين صندوق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى أمين الصندوق مسؤولية الإدارة المالية والتخطيط، بما في ذلك إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة والتمويل. يركز الدور على تحليل السيولة وأسعار الفائدة والعملات والمخاطر المرتبطة بها لضمان الاستقرار المالي للمؤسسة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الأرصدة النقدية اليومية وتحليل التدفق النقدي من العمليات والاستثمار والتمويل، مع ضمان كفاية التدفقات النقدية. توقع المدفوعات النقدية والتنبؤ بالمشكلات المحتملة الناتجة عن محدودية التدفق النقدي. تحليل متطلبات رأس المال للعمليات التجارية والمعاملات والالتزامات الأخرى. تقديم الدعم في وضع سياسات وإجراءات الرقابة الداخلية المتعلقة بإدارة الموازنة والنقد والائتمان والمحاسبة. تحليل وإدارة المخاطر المرتبطة بالتدفقات النقدية، وإجراء تحليل الحساسية لتقييم تقلبات التدفقات النقدية فيما يتعلق بالمخاطر التشغيلية والتمويلية. تحليل وتحديد خيارات شروط التمويل لتناسب الاحتياجات التشغيلية والاستثمارية، والسعي للحصول على مصادر التمويل والتفاوض حول شروطها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ الإدارة المالية والتدفقات النقدية. القدرة على إجراء التحليلات المالية المعقدة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل أمين الصندوق ضمن فريق مالي متخصص لدعم الأهداف الاستراتيجية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة أموري ديل باشن.

0d1378c53d45b47d.description: Cooperative Training Program Overview SABIC is offering Cooperative Training (Co-op) opportunities for university and college students. This program is designed to provide practical experience and professional development within a leading organization. The internships are available across SABIC's locations in Saudi Arabia, specifically in Al Jubail, Riyadh, and Yanbu. This is an internship position with 0-1 years of experience required. Program Purpose The Cooperative Training Program aims to equip students with hands-on experience and real workplace exposure. Participants will engage in daily tasks and projects, working alongside professional teams and mentors to develop essential skills for their future careers. Fields of Study SABIC welcomes applications from students across various technical and administrative disciplines. These include, but are not limited to, the following areas: Engineering disciplines (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial) Information Technology & Computer Science Business Administration, Human Resources, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain Training Experience During the training period, students will undertake a range of activities designed to foster their professional growth. Key aspects of the training include: Gaining practical experience through involvement in real projects and daily operational tasks. Collaborating closely with professional teams and receiving guidance from assigned mentors. Developing technical, administrative, and communication skills relevant to their field of study. Building a foundational understanding that supports future career opportunities within their chosen profession. Application Information Students who are motivated and eager to acquire practical experience that complements their academic and professional development are encouraged to apply for the upcoming Co-op program. The salary for this internship is not disclosed.

0d52e8b67a4561e2.description: About BAE Systems Saudi Arabia BAE Systems operates as the UK Government’s nominated Prime Contractor under Government-to-Government arrangements, providing equipment, support, and training to Saudi Arabia. The company is responsible for the maintenance of Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF) aircraft and for training RSAF and Royal Saudi Naval Force personnel in the safe use of aircraft, equipment, and weapons. BAE Systems Saudi Arabia supports the Saudi Arabian National Agenda, including Saudisation and the development of Saudi National capability through partner companies, reinforcing industrialisation and partnerships. The Role of Instructor Pilot (Basic) BAE Systems is seeking an Instructor Pilot (Basic) to deliver flight and ground training services to assigned cadets. This full-time position is based in Al Majma'ah and involves instructing on the PC-21 aircraft. The role requires over 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Conduct flying instructional missions for cadets in accordance with Royal Saudi Air Force training syllabi. Perform flying operations and cadet training in compliance with KSA Company Flying Regulations and RSAF Regulations. Identify aviation safety risks and propose mitigating recommendations to the Squadron Supervisor. Maintain a working knowledge of SafeTal incident reporting and familiarity with the flying operations Hazard (Risk) Log in both Hazard and FORM modules. Provide air operations subject matter expertise to the Squadron Supervisor upon request. Execute duties and delegated tasks from the Squadron Supervisor as directed. Highlight cadet training issues to Squadron Supervisory staff. Adhere to Squadron Supervisor policies and processes. Monitor and evaluate the progress of assigned cadets and advise Squadron Supervisory staff of any issues. Generate reports as required by Squadron Supervisory staff. Maintain cultural awareness with the customer at all times. Conform to required standards and operating procedures in line with customer needs. Monitor the Aviation Safety culture within the Squadron to ensure adherence to required standards. Self-monitor fatigue levels according to the KFAA Aircrew Fatigue Management Plan and communicate any concerns to Squadron Supervisory staff. Advise the Squadron Supervisor of factors adversely affecting safe operations. Deliver ground training lectures and synthetic device missions to cadets as scheduled. Candidate Requirements Over 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Ability to deliver flight and ground training effectively. Strong understanding of aviation safety protocols and risk mitigation. Proficiency in monitoring and evaluating cadet progress. Commitment to maintaining cultural awareness and adherence to operational standards. Benefits for Expatriate Employees Expatriate employees will receive a competitive salary, rent-free accommodation, and access to free recreation facilities within Company-secured accommodation. Benefits also include a generous leave and travel allowance. Initial appointment to Saudi Arabia will be on single status, with the opportunity to apply for family to join in the future. A full health care scheme is provided within Saudi Arabia. Benefits for Saudi National Employees Saudi National employees will receive a competitive salary and benefits package. This includes a generous leave and travel allowance, a full health care scheme, and access to subsidised recreational facilities.

0dda68af86d36598.job_title: فرص عمل موسمية للسعوديين – محاسب زبائن (كاشير)
0dda68af86d36598.description: فرصة عمل موسمية – محاسب زبائن (كاشير) نبحث عن محاسبي زبائن سعوديين، ممن تزيد أعمارهم على 18 عامًا، للعمل لمدة شهر في فروع الشركة بجميع أنحاء المملكة. تفاصيل العمل: الراتب الشهري: 3,000 ريال سعودي. ساعات العمل: 9 ساعات يوميًا، تشمل ساعة راحة. الإجازة الأسبوعية: يومان. المهام والمسؤوليات: استقبال العملاء وتقديم خدمة مميزة. تسجيل المنتجات وإتمام عمليات البيع عبر نظام نقاط البيع. تحصيل المدفوعات النقدية والإلكترونية بدقة. مطابقة النقدية مع تقارير المبيعات وتسليم العهدة. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب منطقة الكاشير. إبلاغ المشرف عن أي فروقات مالية أو مشكلات أثناء العمل. المتطلبات: سعودي الجنسية، والعمر أكبر من 18 عامًا. التفرغ للعمل طوال مدة الشهر. الالتزام بالمواعيد والاستعداد للعمل بنظام الورديات. مهارات جيدة في التواصل وخدمة العملاء. الدقة والأمانة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. تُعطى الأولوية لمن لديه بطاقة بلدية «شهادة صحية» سارية أو فحص طبي ساري المفعول.

0d434ae2350a5216.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سلوكيرا عن مسؤول مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تنفيذ عمليات البيع عن بُعد، والتواصل الفعال مع العملاء المحتملين لتقديم منتجات وخدمات الشركة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية التواصل مع العملاء المحتملين لتنفيذ عمليات البيع عن بُعد. التعريف بمنتجات وخدمات الشركة بشكل واضح ومفصل. فهم احتياجات العملاء وتقديم الحلول المناسبة لهم. متابعة فرص البيع من البداية وحتى إتمام عملية الشراء. العمل على تحقيق الأهداف والمستهدفات البيعية المحددة. بناء علاقات طويلة الأمد ومستدامة مع العملاء. الالتزام بتقديم تجربة احترافية ومميزة للعملاء في جميع الأوقات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التواصل بفعالية وتقديم عروض تقديمية واضحة. مهارات قوية في بناء العلاقات مع العملاء. القدرة على العمل لتحقيق الأهداف البيعية. بيئة العمل ونوع التوظيف هذا الدور متاح بنظام الدوام الكامل في مدينة الرياض. يعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق النمو وبناء قاعدة عملاء قوية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للانضمام إلى فريق سلوكيرا.

0d6d9d8054bcfbb7.description: About the Position We are looking for an experienced and ambitious International Logistics Sales Executive to join our growing team in Riyadh. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in freight forwarding and logistics sales, excellent communication skills, and the ability to independently develop new business opportunities in the Saudi market. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new business opportunities in the Saudi market. Acquire new customers, particularly importers, trading companies, manufacturers, and distributors. Promote international freight forwarding services, including FCL, sea freight, air freight, and DDP solutions. Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers. Arrange customer meetings, prepare quotations, negotiate rates, and close deals. Follow up with potential customers and convert leads into actual shipments. Coordinate with the China and Saudi operations teams to ensure smooth service delivery. Achieve sales targets and maintain regular sales activity reports. Requirements Native Arabic speaker. Good command of English for business communication. Basic Chinese communication skills are an advantage. Minimum 3 years of proven sales experience in freight forwarding or international logistics. Good understanding of sea freight, FCL, LCL, and international shipping processes. Familiarity with the Saudi logistics and import market. Existing customer network in Saudi Arabia is highly preferred. Strong communication, negotiation, and customer acquisition skills. Self-motivated, proactive, and target-oriented. Valid Saudi driving license is preferred. What We Offer Competitive salary based on experience. Attractive performance-based sales commission. Opportunity to grow with an international logistics company. Professional working environment. How to Apply Please send your updated CV along with a brief description of your previous logistics sales experience and achievements.

0d77a4c62cf0c62f.description: About Jasara Program Management Company Jasara Program Management Company was established as a joint venture between Aramco, Jacobs, and the Public Investment Fund. The company operates in the civil engineering sector, supporting complex programs that require strong coordination, regulatory understanding, and disciplined project delivery within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The Role of Senior Permitting Manager Jasara is seeking a Senior Permitting Manager to lead critical permitting activities for major projects. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires a professional with over 10 years of experience. The Senior Permitting Manager will guide regulatory strategy, support delivery teams through complex approval pathways, and provide clear visibility on permitting progress, risks, and dependencies. Key Responsibilities Conduct permitting feasibility studies to identify required approvals and regulatory risks. Develop and manage the master permitting schedule. Serve as the primary point of contact with government agencies, utilities, and regulatory boards. Oversee the preparation, review, and submission of permit applications and supporting documentation. Manage agency RFIs and formal comments through resolution. Integrate permit conditions into construction schedules and site logistics plans. Coordinate with architects and engineers to align permit submissions with project execution. Monitor permitting budgets, agency fees, and consultant costs. Provide status updates on permitting milestones, risks, and potential delays to the PMCM team and project owners. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in permitting management. Currently based in Saudi Arabia and eligible for local transfer. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires a professional who can effectively manage complex regulatory processes within the Kingdom.

0dbd6fd4cb54faf8.description: About the Role Echelon is seeking a Head of Applied AI to lead its applied AI engineering efforts. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves overseeing the team, technology, and technical quality of all deployed solutions. The role reports directly to the Managing Director and requires a minimum of 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Define the technical direction for engagements, including architecture, model and partner selections, and build, partner, or buy decisions. Build and lead forward-deployed engineering teams, design pods, set hiring standards, define career paths, and cultivate an engineering culture. Ensure the technical quality of deployments from prototype to production, approving scope, architecture, and technical risk. Act as the senior technical counterpart in strategic pursuits, conducting architecture, security, and data-residency reviews, and shaping engagement scope and pricing. Establish standards for building, securing, and operating AI systems, ensuring compliance with data protection and security regulations. Facilitate capability transfer to customers through documentation, evaluations, monitoring, training, and clean handovers. Collaborate with the platform lead to shape Echelon’s platform roadmap based on delivery patterns and customer needs. Lead technical relationships with technology partners and model providers across engagements. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 6 years of experience in engineering, including building and leading teams that deliver production systems, ideally as a senior leader in an AI company, a forward-deployed business, or as a technical founder. Demonstrated experience taking a product or platform from inception to scaled usage by real users. Hands-on expertise with LLMs, agent frameworks, MCP, retrieval, and evaluation, with knowledge of making AI systems observable, safe, and reliable at scale. Proficiency in distributed systems, data engineering, and cloud and on-premise infrastructure under strict data residency and security constraints. Experience leading complex deployments for large enterprises or government, including technical pre-sales, scoping, and commercial considerations. Ability to communicate complex technical and commercial trade-offs effectively to both engineers and executive boards. Advantageous Qualifications A PhD in AI, Machine Learning, or Computer Science. Experience with delivery in Saudi Arabia or the GCC, particularly in the public sector or regulated industries, with familiarity with PDPL, NCA, and SDAIA frameworks. Experience building Arabic NLP, speech, or multimodal systems; Arabic language proficiency is a plus. Experience with fine-tuning, post-training, or serving open-weight models on private or on-premise infrastructure. Experience leading technical relationships with model providers, cloud providers, or technology partners. Work Environment and Expectations This role is based in Riyadh, with regular travel to customer sites across the region and with partners abroad. The successful candidate will be a senior engineering leader who remains close to the code, fluent in Python, TypeScript, or similar languages, and capable of reviewing shipped code. The role requires a proactive approach to problem-solving, with an emphasis on curiosity, speed, rigor, and resourcefulness. Candidates should be comfortable with ambiguity and committed to long-term building and developing others. Compensation and Benefits Compensation for this position includes a base salary, a performance bonus, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity program. Specific terms will be shared during the offer stage.

0dd77ed455e11c1b.description: About the Role The National Blood & Cancer Center (NBCC) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an experienced OR Nurse for a full-time position. This role involves providing high-quality nursing care to patients undergoing surgical procedures, ensuring patient safety and maintaining a sterile environment throughout the perioperative process. Key Responsibilities Prepare and organize the operating room, ensuring all surgical instruments, equipment, and supplies are available and functioning properly. Assess patients' preoperative needs and verify patient identity, surgical procedures, consent forms, and relevant medical records. Assist surgeons and other members of the surgical team during procedures as required. Perform scrub and circulating nurse duties in accordance with established clinical protocols. Maintain strict aseptic techniques and ensure compliance with infection prevention and control standards. Monitor patients' conditions before, during, and after surgical procedures, in coordination with the anesthesia and surgical teams. Perform surgical instrument, sponge, and needle counts in accordance with established safety protocols. Ensure the proper handling, labeling, and transfer of surgical specimens. Prepare patients for surgery and provide appropriate nursing care during the perioperative period. Recognize and respond promptly to emergencies and changes in patients' conditions. Document nursing assessments, interventions, and surgical procedures accurately in patients' medical records. Ensure proper cleaning, disinfection, sterilization, and storage of surgical instruments and equipment in coordination with the relevant departments. Collaborate effectively with surgeons, anesthesiologists, and other healthcare professionals to ensure safe and efficient surgical care. Comply with hospital policies, clinical guidelines, patient safety requirements, and applicable healthcare regulations. Candidate Requirements Qualified and experienced Operating Room (OR) Nurse. 5-10 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, at the National Blood & Cancer Center.

0ded1b69060c3e45.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a highly experienced Health, Safety & Environment (HS&E) Manager to lead HS&E efforts for a major rail infrastructure project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time leadership position requires a professional with a proven track record of delivering HS&E excellence on large-scale civil engineering or infrastructure projects, particularly within the metro/rail sector. The HS&E Manager will report directly to the Project Director and will be responsible for driving a robust, proactive HS&E management strategy across all project stages. Key Responsibilities The HS&E Manager will lead and manage a team of HS&E professionals, ensuring the project adheres to the Zero Harm philosophy. Responsibilities include both strategic oversight and hands-on engagement across the project environment. Support the Leadership Team, including the Project Manager, Deputy Project Manager, and Package Managers, in implementing HS&E initiatives. Implement and monitor initiatives to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of HS&E services and delivery. Plan and coordinate continuous improvement HS&E actions across all project phases through workshops and lessons learned reviews. Oversee and review the HS&E requirements of design-build (DB) contractors, including contract compliance, RAMS, and permits to work. Audit, monitor, and report on project and DB contractor HS&E performance. Review, implement, and maintain HS&E management systems in line with regulatory standards. Ensure the project team complies with relevant legislation, engineering, and construction codes and standards. Lead the development and updating of HS&E policies, plans, and procedures to meet joint venture standards and legal requirements. Develop and implement Emergency Preparedness Plans (EPPs), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs), and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Identify hazards, assess safety risks, and develop strategies to ensure product, system, and application safety and reliability. Prepare HS&E documents and processes, such as Risk Assessments and Safe Systems of Work. Investigate and ensure actions are taken to eliminate the cause of potential non-conformities and prevent their recurrence. Report all cases of non-conformity and identify root causes to prevent recurrence. Lead investigation teams for serious incident and accident reports. Prepare and submit reports and follow up on preventative and corrective actions. Required Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess extensive experience in HS&E management within large-scale infrastructure projects, with a specific focus on metro or rail environments. A minimum of 10 years of experience in Health, Safety & Environment management. Demonstrated experience leading HS&E on major rail infrastructure projects. Proven ability to deliver HS&E excellence on multi-million-dollar civil engineering or infrastructure projects. Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage a team of HS&E professionals. Credibility and gravitas to influence complex matrix organizations and build relationships with senior management, project teams, contractors, and clients. Strategic in approach, yet comfortable with hands-on engagement in the project environment. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focusing on a significant regional rail project. The role requires a commitment to continuous improvement and fostering a culture of safety.

0d41c0ed9d7bbce4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب تقويم أسنان ووجه وفكين للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يركز هذا الدور على تشخيص وعلاج أمراض الفم والأسنان التي تتطلب تدخلات تقويمية وجراحية، مع التركيز على تقديم رعاية شاملة لجميع أفراد الأسرة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة ويعمل بنظام الدوام الكامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان التي تحتاج إلى عمليات وأجهزة تقويم لجميع أفراد الأسرة، وإعداد الخطط العلاجية المناسبة. إجراء الفحوصات اللازمة للأسنان والفكين، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية وتحليلها لتشخيص الحالة المرضية بدقة. تجهيز وتطبيق التقويمات للفك والأسنان، بما في ذلك أخذ القياسات ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. معالجة التهابات اللثة وإجراء جراحات تقويم الفكين الصغرى، ووصف العلاجات والأدوية اللازمة. متابعة تجهيز تركيبات التقويمات السنية وتثبيتها، وضمان فعاليتها وراحة المريض. تطوير الممارسات المهنية تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات الحديثة في مجال طب تقويم الأسنان والوجه والفكين. متابعة جميع أفراد الأسرة وملاحظة أمراض الأسنان والوجه والفكين الوراثية والعمل على الوقاية منها. إعداد التقارير والتوثيق إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها بشكل دقيق ومنظم. تقديم التوصيات لتحسين الصحة العامة للأسنان والتقليل من المخاطر التي قد تهددها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال طب تقويم الأسنان والوجه والفكين. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية اللازمة. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب تقويم الأسنان والوجه والفكين ضمن فريق عمل في عيادات صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان في حائل، بنظام الدوام الكامل. يساهم الدور في تقديم خدمات طب الأسنان المتخصصة للمجتمع المحلي.

0dce88e8edac1cb3.description: We are seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to join our Mechanical Services Shops. Mechanical Services Shops is responsible for providing rotating and static equipment repair and fabrication of components. Your primary role is to develop and optimize routes for precision components produced through machining, additive, welding, casting, heat treatment, and related processes. You will ensure designs are executable and that operations achieve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and capacity objectives. You will have at least 15 years of manufacturing-engineering experience, including a minimum of 8 years developing and optimizing industrial production processes for Aerospace or Oil and Gas. Having simulations certification and all siemens certification for NX CAD/CAM/CAE (NX Teamcenter quality associated Certificate, NX CAD Design Associate Level Certificates, NX CAM Manufacturing Associate Certificate, NX Simcenter 3D CAE Associate Certification, NX Additive Manufacturing Associate Certification, NX Teamcenter quality associate Certificate, NX Designer Certified Professional (NX) Certification) is strongly preferred.

0d7fe0c159399130.description: نبذة عن مهندس كهربائي تبحث فرع شركة المشروعات البترولية المصرية عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وإعداد برامج الصيانة للأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات لخطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية في المشاريع الصناعية وفقاً لمتطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية، بالاستناد إلى توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج تشغيل وصيانة المعدات الكهربائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتشخيص الأعطال. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات التواصل الفعال للتعامل مع فرق العمل المختلفة. الالتزام بتطوير الذات ومواكبة التطورات التقنية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق متخصص في فرع شركة المشروعات البترولية المصرية بمدينة تبوك. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل في بيئة تتطلب الدقة والاحترافية في التعامل مع المشاريع الهندسية الكهربائية. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا لتقديم طلباتهم.

0db9bedc2ab51077.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية قيادة وتشغيل الشاحنات الصغيرة لنقل المواد والمعدات بين المواقع المختلفة، مع الالتزام التام بمعايير السلامة المرورية والتشغيلية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال القيادة والنقل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة وتشغيل الشاحنات الصغيرة المخصصة للنقل. نقل المواد والمعدات بأمان وكفاءة بين المواقع المحددة. إجراء الفحص اليومي للمركبة للتأكد من جاهزيتها وسلامتها التشغيلية. الالتزام الصارم بأنظمة المرور والسلامة على الطرق وتعليمات السلامة الخاصة بالموقع. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات كسائق شاحنة صغيرة أو ما يعادلها. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول تتناسب مع نوع المركبات المطلوبة. معرفة جيدة بأنظمة المرور والسلامة على الطرق. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للمركبة. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بمواعيد العمل والمهام الموكلة. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وضمن فريق. الاستعداد للعمل بدوام كامل في مدينة تبوك. بيئة العمل سيعمل السائق ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التنقل بين مواقع العمل المختلفة في تبوك. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية والتشغيلية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وفعالة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم مراجعة جميع الطلبات بعناية.

0d9d65d8388b77d3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فطيرة الفلافل للمطاعم عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة التسجيلات المالية، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عدّ وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية كل وردية عمل، مع التأكد من توفر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقات الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات اللازمة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند الضرورة. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بأسلوب مهني وترحيب، وتلبية طلباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في التعامل مع المبالغ المالية. مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة النقدية والإيصالات. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة سريعة الوتيرة. المرونة في التعامل مع تحديثات الأسعار وتطبيق الخصومات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل موظف الصندوق ضمن فريق المطعم، ويكون مسؤولاً عن نقطة البيع الرئيسية، مما يتطلب تفاعلاً مباشراً مع العملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يمتلكون المهارات والخبرة المطلوبة على التقديم.

بالتفاصيل في مراجعة المخططات والوثائق. القدرة على حل المشكلات الفنية وتقديم الدعم اللازم. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق عمل في شركة التعمير والانشاء بالمنطقة الشرقية، مدينة الخبر. الوظيفة 0d1c089f3d74b293.description: We are looking for an experienced SAP ABAP and Integration Consultant in Riyadh. The role involves developing and maintaining SAP S/4HANA custom solutions, managing integrations, troubleshooting technical issues, and supporting document management and Fiori services. Key Responsibilities Resolve SAP support tickets within agreed service levels, debug ABAP code, and troubleshoot technical defects. Develop and enhance ABAP programs, reports, forms, CDS views, OData services, and Fiori back-end functionalities. Perform manual and automated unit testing while adhering to SAP coding standards and best practices. Manage SAP Process Orchestration (PO) interfaces, mappings, workflows, and composite applications. Monitor integrations and workflows, independently investigate failures, and identify root causes. Support OpenText content management, Fiori Gateway, and Web Dispatcher. Develop and maintain integrations between SAP and internal systems, including government entities. Conduct code reviews, manage transports, and prepare technical documentation, source code, and data dictionaries for client handover. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in SAP ABAP development and integration, with experience delivering 2–3 projects. Experience working on SAP S/4HANA, modern ABAP (7.5x), ABAP for HANA, CDS views, AMDP, OData, and Fiori Gateway. Strong hands-on experience with SAP PO, including PI/XI, BPM, REST/SOAP adapters, mappings, and interface development. Knowledge of IDocs, RFCs, web services, SSL certificates, and single sign-on fundamentals. Fluency in both Arabic and English. SAP certification in ABAP and/or SAP integration technologies such as SAP PO or Integration Suite is preferred. Experience with SAP OpenText Extended ECM, archiving, SAP BTP, CAP, SAPUI5, or clean-core extensions is an advantage. Familiarity with Saudi government integrations, including e-procurement, e-invoicing, and social-insurance APIs, is a plus.

0de0d0f29945574b.description: Role Profile: Job Title: Senior Geologist, Geology & Quality Control II Department: Technical Engineering & Project Management Job location: Al Baitha, Northern Frontier, Saudi Arabia Working hours: 8 hours Type of work : Full time Job post start date: 10/11/2026 Job post end date: 10/25/2026 Maaden Brief: Maaden, established in 1997, is one of the fastest-growing mining companies in the world and the largest multi-commodity mining and metals company in the Middle East. We are leading the development of the mining industry to become the third pillar of Saudi Arabia’s economy by building a world-class, unique, and fully integrated mining value chain. We are pleased to share an exciting opportunity for the below mentioned position. This role offers a chance to contribute to our ambitious growth and play a key part in shaping the future of mining in the Kingdom. OVERALL JOB PURPOSE: The Mine Senior Geologist will be responsible for developing personnel within the grade control drilling team, systems and procedures to provide safe and efficient mining practices. Assigned in the various phases of office, plant, field or laboratory and geosciences work as assignments. Assists with the implementation of approved programs on specific licenses within budget guidelines and ensures technical quality and vastness of mineral deposits and safety of personnel. Participates in the development of exploration programs and budget. Collects and analyses material in mine. The role includes responsibility to provide technical expertise to all departments including Maaden employees and contractors who will operate within the mine. Overall objectives are to provide the Geological expertise of the mining activities required to meet the Refinery bauxite requirement on grade whilst maximizing reserves, minimizing costs and maintaining standards in compliance with MA business plan, which includes adherence to health, safety and environmental objectives and policies. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES: EHS Responsible for ensuring the company’s EHS policy, procedure, and systems are implemented and adhered to by all employees & contractors. Complete all site-specific audits associated with EHS requirement. Technical Quality control Develop and update geological and resource models. Interpret geological, geophysical, and drilling data. Plan and manage grade control drilling programs. Oversee sampling, QA/QC, and database integrity. Conduct production and grade reconciliation activities. Prepare geological reports, maps, and technical presentations. Coordinate with mining, drilling, and resource teams. Ensure resource quality and compliance with customer specifications. Production Overseeing the monthly, Weekly and daily grade control functions Act as the point of contact to the Mine and Refinery for all Geological issues that arise. Planning Mine production Forecast, Short- and Medium-term Planning Planning and Implementation of Grade Control drilling programs as per mine plan Budget & Reporting Participates in annual budget preparation, providing estimates on field and office expenses as well as new equipment required and maintenance. Assists with the preparation of monthly progress reports on field and office activities and submits to department. QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & SKILLS: Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Geology, Geoscience, Geological Engineering, Mining Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant mining/geology experience Skills: This requires adequate planning and analytical skills and the ability to interpret sometimes complex data to reach optimal conclusions. 0d725828378e3e7f.description: HSE Engineer Work Location: Dammam, Saudi Arabia Job Responsibilities: - Take overall responsibility for on-site Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) management. Develop and implement project HSE plans, safety regulations, and emergency response plans in strict accordance with local Saudi standards and codes. - Organize mandatory pre-entry safety induction, professional safety training, and regular emergency drills. These cover working at height, crane lifting operations, hot work, temporary power utilization, confined space operation, and deep foundation pit construction. Ensure full safety disclosure and certified operation of all on-site staff. - Conduct daily comprehensive site patrols to identify potential safety hazards in a timely manner. Issue hazard rectification notices, track the rectification process, and manage closed-loop safety procedures. Establish complete safety ledgers, focusing on risk control and supervision of high-risk construction procedures such as high-altitude operation, hoisting operation, deep foundation pit construction, temporary electricity use, and mechanical operation. - Supervise the construction behaviors of subcontractors, suppliers, and third-party personnel to ensure full compliance with Saudi local safety specifications and project HSE management requirements. Audit and verify the HSE construction plans, qualification certificates, and staff training records of all subcontractors. - Take charge of on-site occupational health management and medical support. Strictly implement PPE wearing specifications and occupational disease prevention measures. Manage and control high temperature, dust, and noise hazards at the construction site. Standardize the disposal process of construction waste, on-site dust, domestic sewage, and hazardous materials to meet local environmental compliance requirements. - Conduct on-site investigation of safety accidents and near-miss incidents. Analyze root causes of risks, formulate targeted rectification schemes and preventive measures, and complete relevant reports and file archiving. Independently compile HSE daily, weekly, and monthly reports, meeting minutes, and all compliance certification documents. - Actively liaise and communicate with the Saudi Ministry of Labor, municipal government, and relevant regulatory authorities. Ensure all project construction activities fully comply with Saudi Building Code (SBC), industrial specifications, and local environmental protection laws and regulations. Complete relevant approval and filing work. - Promote the construction of on-site safety culture. Organize safety assessment, safety publicity, and special HSE promotion activities continuously. Iterate and optimize the project HSE management system to reduce construction risks. Job Requirements: - Bachelor’s degree or above in Safety Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or other related engineering majors. - At least 3 years of formal HSE management working experience in infrastructure, building construction, or municipal engineering projects. Candidates with Saudi Arabia or Middle East on-site construction experience are highly preferred. - Priority will be given to candidates holding Saudi government-approved safety certificates, OSHA, NEBOSH, ISO45001, and other authoritative safety certification qualifications. Familiarity with Saudi Building Code (SBC) and local project safety approval and filing processes is required. - Proficient in Microsoft Office software. Possess outstanding risk identification ability, on-site execution, and cross-department communication and coordination capabilities. Able to be stationed at the Dammam construction site for long-term on-site work. - Fluent in English (used as the daily working language). Arabic proficiency is a bonus. Strong sense of responsibility and pressure resistance, capable of independently judging and handling various on-site safety emergencies and abnormal situations.
